notes.title: Our New Mechanic Simulator's Prologue Releasing Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone!
[/h1]
Our upcoming game, [b]Rally Mechanic Simulator[/b], is getting a prologue soon! If you’d like to see how the spiritual successor of Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator plays, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/]wishlist it here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/76aa21cfd74c45c006c3d13648780e93d4d6c136.png[/img]

You’ll become the head mechanic of your very own rally team. Adapt your cars to the upcoming challenges, take part in rallies and win them! 

Compared to the already available demo, the prologue is more polished and features a [b]test drive mode[/b], so you will get to see how your car’s handling will change after you make modifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/d04c4c8f9d0773d6229beee7470cbeda1432970f.gif[/img]

We expect to release the prologue in the near future. As for now, you can wishlist it and wait a short while for it to release!:)

tags.feature: Compared to the already available demo, the prologue is more polished and features a test drive mode, so you will get to see how your car’s handling will change after you make modifications.

notes.title: Patch #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/e67ad99e1fb82547b79fd67609a561442ebbb345.gif[/img]

Hey, Bikers!

[h1]IMPORTANT NEWS REGARDING A NEW UPDATE:[/h1]

In order to fix some issues with loading our game, we had to change the directories of some files. This means that all of the saved game files will not be visible after you do the update. 
You can fix it by moving files from the "Saved" folder [i]from[/i]:
[list][b]C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Play2ChillSA\Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator 2021 Prologue[/b][/list][i]to[/i]
[list][b]C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Play2ChillSA\MMS21P[/b][/list]

This should fix the missing save files. We are sorry for this inconvenience.

Changelog of the patch
[list]
[*] We added new animations for screw and parts on assembly and disassembly.
[*] We fixed the workflow with screw nuts to be more entertaining.
[*] We added some tweaks and fixes to the camera flow when working with a motorcycle.
[*] We optimized looking on motorcycles, so camera freezes should happen less frequently.
[*] We optimized the rendering and changed lights in the garage scene.
[*] We added new notifications in inventory when you are working with balanced wheels.
[*] We added new notifications in inventory when you trying to mount a part, when it's not suitable to its parent.
[*] We added credits to the main menu
[*] We changed some issues with the black screen on loading the game. Some people should now be able to open the game.
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/72bf8e2fac955620f0d5ba32d77f23e589808b97.png[/img][/url]

Have a great weekend guys!

notes.title: Major Content Update - Patch #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/a2b603b297c7ebd90d705e3dde630ea5fa4e7e76.gif[/img]

Hey, Bikers!

We just released a new update with lots of [b]new stuff[/b]! Feel free to play our game again and see what there is to discover!

[list]
[*] We've [b]added 2 new quests[/b] to the game, slightly more complicated and therefore more interesting.
[*] We added a [b]new quest type[/b] inside the old and new quests! - Extra Goal. These quests don't have strict instructions on what to do, they are just hints on where to look for extra work. For example, "I hear something strange happening when I speed up". It's up to you whether you want to explore motoring to make more cash or stay with your main goals. 
[*] We have changed the flow and look of the shopping list
[*] You can now [b]paint your rims![/b]
[*] We fixed a lot of memory and optimization issues, so the game should run smoother!
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this big update, there are some new objectives to play and lots of rims to paint!

What's more, we have some decals here for you to import into your [b]Decal Library[/b]. We encourage you to play around with this cool feature, the effects may amaze you!
[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dEeDS3ErolKGbyeRTAIp82s_LhuNr6Vt?usp=sharing][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/61680c156ab77f53df9f41792c44c1c1aeb22a37.png[/img][/url]

Have a great weekend guys!

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/f7c907f9497ac7bffccabfa05d13325ced2bbdab.gif[/img]

Hey Bikers!
Again, we would like to thank you for all your comments and feedback. The goal of the prologue from the beginning was to uncover bugs, explore the flow of functionality, and gather expectations from players. So remember to join our discord, we'd love to hear more of your suggestions and comments. 

Today we are releasing a new patch. Here is what you can expect:
[list]
[*] We changed the flow of UI and tablet. Now you don't have to click every time through every app and shop. Now if you press TAB, it will save the last state and ESC will go back to the previous app/tablet view.
[*] We changed some flow of inventory, now when you select the part for painting, balancing, etc, you don't have to click accept. Everything is smoother and faster.
[*] We adjusted the lengths of some animations in UI so it's smoother and faster
[*] We added more red outlines and hints while disassembling
[*] We added the "bucket paint" feature to the paint table, you can now paint the whole part with one click
[*] We added multi sell feature to inventory, you can now select multiple parts and sell them in one click
[*] We changed some backend asset flow, so the game has better RAM performance now
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue where fork legs were mounted in the air in Falcon
[*] We fixed an issue where the rim was not mounted with a tire in Falcon
[*] We fixed an issue where splash screen error caused people to have an infinite loading screen
[*] We fixed an issue, where sometimes a level was not loaded properly
[*] Fixed some issues with audio balancing
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes photo mode filters were not working properly
[*] Fixed some issues with shop categories
[*] Fixed some issues with modern rims not showing properly in machines
[/list]

We are investigating an issue where some people cannot open the game at all. It has something to do with graphics compatibility. We made some changes to this build, so it could be fixed but we need your feedback so we can do some more testing.

We are also working on some optimization issues, some people encounter heavy lag spikes while looking at motorcycles.

[url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/72bf8e2fac955620f0d5ba32d77f23e589808b97.png[/img][/url]

[b]Remember to add to your wishlist our full game:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078760/Motorcycle_Mechanic_Simulator_2021/

We work non-stop!

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/0a9d58714418519877a94d387be6ca5a83840b70.gif[/img]

Hey Bikers,

We would like to thank you very much for your suggestions and comments so far, please join our discord, there you will always get information from us faster. You can also chat with us. In the meantime,
we are working hard on fixing some bugs and adding some features to our prologue! Be sure to check them out!

- We added some additional white outline to small parts that you need to mount on your motorcycle
- We added some more red outline to small parts while disassembling
- We fixed some issues with displaying motorcycle during the test drive
- We fixed some issues with forks and displaying parts
- We fixed some issues with handlebars displaying wrong
- We fixed issues with some textures
- We changed driver animations while riding a dirt bike
- Some tutorial parts now shine to give some hints
- We blocked a photo mode during working with a motorcycle
- We fixed issues with a flashlight
- We added a simple shopping list feature. You can now add missing parts to a shopping list. Find those parts in Motorcycle Status and click a little note icon next to the part name. This is a simple feature just to give you hints on what to buy, we will expand on it later on.
- We fixed an issue where liquids were resetting after driving a bike
- We fixed some issues with liquids and quests
- We fixed an issue where the engine cover was blocking the mounting of some smaller parts in a dirt bike
- We added some small changes to the driving scene
- We fixed some issues with the photo mode during driving


[url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/72bf8e2fac955620f0d5ba32d77f23e589808b97.png[/img][/url]

High five!
